behavior.scope: physical gifts to living player brothers after no main-inventory slot or merge is available
behavior.order: breadth first; siblings sorted by row, column and object ID

fixture_details: Temporary light copies of original container and item prototypes keep the actor within native capacity; all originals are restored.

Original interpreter method tables and bytecode are patched only in memory, within scoped restoration, for receive acceptance/refusal and insertion refusal/source mutation. No input archive is written.
Portrait and map events queue the original task; real motion updates finish delivery. The map target cache is populated from the original sprite picker.
Immediate destination-icon pixels and the grid after a normal world frame are compared with a full redraw. Transparent frame gaps require the normal world update after motion.
Checkpoints restore all temporary objects, prototypes, actors, queued actions and RNG before the reference scenario continues.
limitations: Automated injected input and dummy gameplay backends; native Windows video is tested separately.
Native MSVC/macOS builds, manual hardware input and a full playthrough are not validated for this release.
